top_signals.title: Crude Oil is Underpriced, Energy Aspects Says
top_signals.summary: Oil futures prices are disconnected from reality on the ground in the Middle East and should be trading closer to $150 a barrel for some physical crude prices, Amrita Sen, founder and director of market intelligence at Energy Aspects, told CNBC on Friday.
